note: Numbering instance. Supply abstractNumId to reuse a template, or format/text/indent/type to create a matching abstractNum automatically. New instances restart level 0 by default; pass continue=true to retain Word's continuation behavior. Remove clears all direct paragraph bindings to this numId across the document, headers, footers, footnotes and endnotes.

format.description: Without abstractNumId, creates a matching numbering template.

text.description: Level-0 marker text for an auto-created template.

indent.description: Template indentation when using format-based auto-create.

startOverride.N.description: Per-level start override; N must be 0 through 8.

continue.description: Do not add the default level-0 restart override.
